title: The bound project remote is readable: POST /repository/remote/read
description:

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: one daemon read route and its wiring. No control-room change (child 3 lands the decoder + proxy pins), no offer change.

FEATURE: `POST /repository/remote/read` with body exactly `{}` under the GOAL capability (same gate as /goals/source/read) answers `{ outcome: "REMOTE", remoteUrl: string|null, boundAt: string|null, boundBy: string|null, readAt }` from child 1's `readProjectRemote`; refusals REPOSITORY_REMOTE_READ_CAPABILITY_DENIED / _PROJECT_MISMATCH / _UNREADABLE (module-private layer "REPOSITORY_REMOTE_READ" - a private column-0 `*_LAYER` const is a layer-visibility allowlist entry: tests/security/layer-visibility-cases.ts UNSCANNED_PRIVATE_LAYERS + EXPECTED_PRIVATE_COUNT, memory task-task-741dad13e23d441a8385d0f14df5b5c1-handoff - OR reuse the pattern sessions-read uses for its LAYER const exactly as it is declared there; measure which shape the scan counts and follow it); a non-POST refuses LISTENER_REPOSITORY_REMOTE_REQUEST_INVALID like the sessions route.
definitionOfDone: Over a REAL daemon listener (the sessions-read test harness pattern): `POST /repository/remote/read {}` answers {outcome:"REMOTE", remoteUrl, boundAt, boundBy, readAt} with nulls before any publish and the bound values after child 1's binding; exact keys asserted; a body other than `{}` and a non-POST are refused with the named codes (code + layer asserted).

Capability gate: an agent (non-GOAL) credential refuses REPOSITORY_REMOTE_READ_CAPABILITY_DENIED; a credential bound to another project refuses _PROJECT_MISMATCH; the route is NOT on the MCP allowlist (mcp-tool-allowlist test count line quoted).

All wiring touchpoints named and landed: route module + .js bridge, composition factory, store-dependencies provider key, daemon-entry resolution, listener options + dispatch registration, `providerKeys` pin updated (run it red first, quote the diff); any new column-0 `*_LAYER` const is added to the layer-visibility allowlist with its count bump (or the existing declared shape is reused - state which).

Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test:security` (layer census); http-listener-read-dispatch.ts grows by no more than the import + 4 lines (pre-existing 502 lines recorded, not fixed here).
taskRails: PURE DAEMON LEAF: no control-room file (child 3 owns the decoder and proxy pins), no offer change, no command change.
EXACT-KEY READ: the response roster is fixed and asserted; every wiring touchpoint is named in the plan (8-touchpoint pattern) - a missing `.js` bridge kills the daemon at boot.
Refusals assert code AND layer; mutate to prove red (global rail 1). <=250 lines per new production source; the dispatch file is pre-existing debt - touch it minimally and record its size.
